name: zdi_set_object3d_color_mode_for_materials
description: zDi::SetObject3DColorModeForMaterials applies an Object3D color mode to each non-textured material in a DI entry array.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this small DI material helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel/zDi source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x484350 validates direct entry iteration by 0x1c-byte stride, skipping materials with flag 0x0100, storing the integer color mode as colorRgb.red, clearing colorRgb.green and colorRgb.blue, writing the low color-mode byte to the high byte of packedColor, preserving the low packedColor byte, and resetting colorScalar to 1.0.
The native smoke verifies two eligible materials are updated, a flag-0x0100 material is preserved, the packedColor low byte is retained, and colorScalar is reset.
